import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    ids = list(feats.ids)
    types = list(feats.types)
    x = feats.x
    y = feats.y
    
    # Identify correlated pairs with |r| >= 0.6
    corr_pairs = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if abs(np.corrcoef(x[:,i], x[:,j])[0,1]) >= 0.6:
                corr_pairs.add((min(ids[i], ids[j]), max(ids[i], ids[j])))
    
    # Group correlated features
    groups = []
    used = set()
    for i in range(len(ids)):
        if ids[i] in used:
            continue
        group = [ids[i]]
        used.add(ids[i])
        for j in range(i+1, len(ids)):
            if (ids[i], ids[j]) in corr_pairs or (ids[j], ids[i]) in corr_pairs:
                group.append(ids[j])
                used.add(ids[j])
        groups.append(group)
    
    # Select representative from each group (highest mean_y1-mean_y0)
    representatives = []
    for group in groups:
        if len(group) == 1:
            representatives.append(group[0])
        else:
            # Select feature with highest effect size (mean_y1-mean_y0)
            best_idx = None
            best_effect = -np.inf
            for fid in group:
                col = feats.column(fid)
                effect = np.mean(x[y==1, col]) - np.mean(x[y==0, col])
                if effect > best_effect:
                    best_effect = effect
                    best_idx = fid
            representatives.append(best_idx)
    
    # Calculate effect sizes for all features
    effects = []
    for fid in representatives:
        col = feats.column(fid)
        effect = np.mean(x[y==1, col]) - np.mean(x[y==0, col])
        effects.append((fid, effect))
    
    # Sort by absolute effect size
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[1]), reverse=True)
    
    # Select top drivers (at most MAX_DRIVERS)
    drivers = [fid for fid, _ in effects[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Build columns and products
    columns = []
    products = []
    loadings = {}
    
    # Add main effects
    columns.extend(representatives)
    
    # Add interaction terms for top 3 drivers
    for i in range(min(3, len(drivers))):
        for j in range(i+1, min(3, len(drivers))):
            products.append((drivers[i], drivers[j]))
    
    # Simple weighted score using top features
    for i, fid in enumerate(representatives[:5]):
        loadings[fid] = 1.0 / (i + 1)
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
